narratives.Description: Aggregate directive's existing static gates such as render-staleness, dead cross-refs, conformance, encoding, and template propagation drift, plus a new contradictory-gate detector, into a single per-version framework health score. This tier is the cheapest, model-free, highest-ROI signal and is trended over time.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
- Add an eval:health module that runs the existing static verifiers and aggregates their results into a versioned score.
- Add the contradictory-gate detector and tests asserting the wipCap-class unsatisfiable-nudge is reported as evidence.
narratives.UserStory: As a directive maintainer, I want a versioned framework health score, so that I can trend static self-consistency across releases without running any agent.
narratives.Traces: #1703 Tier 0; #1694 wipCap self-contradiction is the canonical detector case.

narrative.Acceptance: task eval:health emits a versioned framework health score aggregated from the existing static gates.
When a gate contradicts another gate, the detector records the unsatisfiable-nudge contradiction.
The health run persists each score to a versioned store so runs can be trended across releases.

expected_outputs: task eval:health versioned framework health score

references.title: Issue #1703: RFC: measuring directive version-over-version performance -- tiered framework-eval model
